# Plot examples

The native captures show LinkEDA itself. The remaining examples were generated reproducibly in R from `mtcars` or `airquality`, using the variables and panel structures accepted by the corresponding LinkEDA plot.

## Interactive demonstrations

:::: {.demo-gallery}
::: {.demo-card .demo-wide}
<img src="assets/demos/linked-bar-selection.gif" alt="Animated native LinkEDA capture: selecting the four-cylinder bar highlights the corresponding observations in a linked scatterplot.">
<div class="demo-card-caption"><h3>Selection across linked plots</h3><span>Select a bar → the same cases light up in the scatterplot</span></div>
:::

::: {.demo-card}
<img src="assets/demos/point-colors-regression.gif" alt="Animated native LinkEDA capture: groups of points receive different colors and separate regression lines are displayed for each point color.">
<div class="demo-card-caption"><h3>Point colors and regressions</h3><span>Color selected points → regression by point color</span></div>
:::

::: {.demo-card}
<img src="assets/demos/selected-regression.gif" alt="Animated native LinkEDA capture: a regression line is recalculated when a different subset of scatterplot points is selected.">
<div class="demo-card-caption"><h3>Regression for selected points</h3><span>Change the selection → the fitted line updates</span></div>
:::

::: {.demo-card .demo-wide}
<img src="assets/demos/parallel-variable-change.gif" alt="Animated native LinkEDA capture: clicking the cyl label in a parallel-coordinates plot opens its variable menu and replaces cyl with qsec.">
<div class="demo-card-caption"><h3>Change a parallel-coordinate variable</h3><span>Click `cyl` → Replace Variable → `qsec`</span></div>
:::
::::

## Context menu to analysis

<img class="screenshot-wide" src="assets/screenshots/context-menu.gif" alt="Animated native capture: a LinkEDA boxplot context menu opens, Descriptive statistics is chosen, and the resulting Table 1 window appears in full.">

::: {.visual-note}
Right-click → **Analyze This Boxplot** → **Descriptive statistics** → native **Table 1** window.
:::

## Linked selection

:::: {.selection-strip}
::: {.selection-step}
<span>1</span><strong>Select a point, row or aggregate mark</strong>
:::
::: {.selection-arrow aria-hidden="true"}
→
:::
::: {.selection-step}
<span>2</span><strong>LinkEDA retains the original row identities</strong>
:::
::: {.selection-arrow aria-hidden="true"}
→
:::
::: {.selection-step}
<span>3</span><strong>Every linked view redraws the same cases</strong>
